title: Replace an approval with changes requested without losing the approval
preconditions: Use a valid review slide and one human reviewer seat at a fixed committed head.

steps.action: Approve the slide, then submit changes requested with a reason.
steps.expected_result: The current seat decision is changes requested.

steps.action: After the two-action replacement scenario, inspect the review decision history.
steps.expected_result: Both the earlier approval and later changes-requested action remain recorded in time order.

steps.action: Separately run the store fixture sequence of human and AI decisions at two heads plus withdrawals, then load all seven events.
steps.expected_result: Seven events remain and the original human approval retains its ID, state and actor.

expected_result: Both the earlier approval and later changes-requested action remain recorded in time order.
